diagnostics.message: module.eks_managed_node_group:resource.aws_eks_node_group.this should depend on module.eks_managed_node_group:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this so EKS role permissions are attached before node-group handling and remain attached until the node group is deleted. The provider documentation recommends this explicit ordering; the existing role ARN reference only orders the role itself.

module.fargate_profile:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.this should depend on module.fargate_profile:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this. The profile references the execution role, but that alone does not ensure the required Fargate pod execution permissions are attached before the profile can be used to launch pods.
